raw: {"found": true, "passages": ["Unless otherwise disallowed by a Bank Card association, Bank agrees to maintain such sponsorships throughout the term of this Agreement and until the first of either to occur: (i) [***] days after the expiration or earlier termination of this Agreement, or (ii) the effective date of the assignment of all of the Merchant Processing Agreements or all of the BINs/ICAs and other items specified and contemplated in Section 10.4.", "Upon a Program Transfer in accordance with Section 10.4, Bank will transfer the dedicated BINs/ICAs used in connection with the Program to a Visa and MasterCard Member designated by ISO.", "Bank acknowledges and agrees that ISO shall own and maintain the Merchant relationship during the term of this Agreement and thereafter."]}
